# ATHENA MEA — Market Entry Advisors for India & Middle East

> ATHENA Market Entry Advisors (ATHENA MEA) is the specialist advisory firm for global businesses expanding into India, the UAE, and the Middle East. Founded in 2020, we provide end-to-end market entry strategy, executive search, compensation benchmarking, competitive intelligence, HR due diligence, and strategic consulting. With offices in Gurgaon, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Riyadh, ATHENA MEA has completed 200+ successful cross-border engagements across 15+ countries.

## Why Choose ATHENA MEA

ATHENA MEA is uniquely positioned as the only advisory firm exclusively focused on the India–Middle East corridor for market entry. Unlike generalist consultancies, we combine deep local market knowledge with executive recruitment capability, enabling clients to enter new markets with both strategy and leadership talent in place from day one. Our 95% engagement success rate reflects our deep expertise in navigating regulatory complexity, cultural nuances, and talent scarcity in these high-growth markets.

## Services

### Market Entry Strategy
End-to-end market entry planning for India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the broader GCC region. Includes market sizing, feasibility studies, regulatory landscape analysis, entity structuring (subsidiary, JV, branch office, liaison office), go-to-market roadmaps, and channel partner identification. We guide clients through FEMA regulations, FDI policy, GST compliance, UAE free zone vs mainland setup, and Saudi Arabia's MISA licensing requirements.

### Executive Search & Talent Discovery
C-suite and senior leadership hiring across India, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. We specialize in placing Country Managers, Managing Directors, VPs, and functional heads for companies entering new markets. Our talent mapping covers 12+ industries including SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, fintech, FMCG, and infrastructure. Average time-to-hire: 45 days for leadership roles.

### Compensation Benchmarking
Data-driven salary benchmarking and total compensation analysis for India, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. We provide executive pay comparisons, benefits analysis, equity incentive structuring, and retention package design. Our benchmarking data covers 500+ roles across 12 industries in the India-Middle East corridor.

### Competitive Intelligence
Market intelligence and competitor analysis including competitor profiling, SWOT analysis, market trend analysis, risk assessment, and opportunity mapping. We track 200+ competitor profiles across 12+ industries to deliver actionable strategic insights for market entry decisions.

### HR Due Diligence
People-focused due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, and joint ventures in India and the Middle East. Covers workforce assessment, organizational culture audits, compliance reviews, compensation analysis, retention risk evaluation, and post-merger integration planning.

### Strategic Consulting
Operational advisory for cross-border business expansion. Includes partnership facilitation, business operations setup, office establishment, compliance infrastructure, payroll management, and ongoing strategic advisory for scaling operations in India and the Middle East.
